verdict.rationale: Figma ships a built-in agent that takes natural-language direction to generate design directions, create diagrams, edit images and search files, and lets users riff with it to refine designs. Its official MCP server also lets external AI clients write native content to the canvas and generate FigJam diagrams from prompts. One community report says FigJam's AI tools are often broken, and another describes successful AI-driven slide generation, so hands-on reliability is mixed. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the breadth of operations controllable by natural language (beyond marketing summaries), independent corroboration of reliable natural-language canvas editing.
